entities.summary: Changchung Cathedral (Korean: 장충성당) is the nominal cathedral of the Diocese of Pyongyang, North Korea, located in the Changchung neighborhood of Songyo-guyok, Pyongyang. It is one of only four official Christian places of worship in Pyongyang. It operates under the Korean Catholic Association.
